summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Banco Santander, S.A., a foreign private issuer, reporting its Q1 2026 earnings. The press release highlights revenue growth of 4% to €15.1 billion, cost reduction of 3%, and an underlying profit increase of 12% to €3.56 billion. A net capital gain of €1.9 billion from the completed disposal of Santander Bank Polska is included as a non-recurring item. The filing also notes shareholder approval of a final cash dividend of 12.5 euro cents per share, payable May 5, 2026. This is a routine earnings report, not a special situation.
